notes.selection: D-621 (3): CARRIED only if every line holds; a carried cell is a new candidate for its own registered development test
notes.status: EXPLORATORY (D-621, program U): a lever family judged on the user's milestones by the declared selection rule; beside the gate, never a verdict of the gate (D-234); a carried cell is a new candidate, not a change to any verdict
notes.variant_count_rule: one per cell, under D-644:u_firms; the reference cell, the chosen cell's point arm, coin replays and gate floor are readings of cells already counted

blocks.early: starts to the last start of 2023 less the reading's horizon
blocks.late: starts from the first session of 2024 with the reading's horizon left

bootstrap.interval: one-sided: the lower limit is the level's quantile

coin_guard.applies: a coin design's only: not applicable to a cell on base p14
coin_guard.starts: every 21st of the judged block's common start dates

parameters.expensive_lines: the gate floor and the coin guard run for the chosen cell only, each only while every line before it holds (the verdict is the first failing line)

registered_call.p14: a3_brk30_cb20's gate campaign at seed 20261131, 500 paths, against a3_brk30_cb20_gate.csv's section gate rows at 0 % and a3_brk30_cb20_gate_paths.csv's gate run path for path
registered_call.p16: rc_screen.Runner's form at seed 20261131, 500 paths, against rc_width_screen.csv's rc_s150_all row

hypothetical.label: hypothetical_hedge
hypothetical.note: HYPOTHETICAL (D-644 (4), D-514): hypothetical_hedge -- a cross-firm hedge pair, prohibited at Topstep (13747047, 10296582) and Lucid (11404734), tier 1; modelled as if the rule did not exist; never chosen, judged, ranked, a row to beat or a candidate. Also lucid_upper_bound: Lucid's funded monthly fee and payout fee are unpriced, so every figure is an upper bound on them. The bound arm flatters a hedged cell (the bound's shift partly cancels inside a mirrored pair, D-516): read the point arm beside it.
hypothetical.written: the scorecard at both arms and the deal's shares, section cell
